answer: A zephyr of cheap throwaway accounts can't buy standing, since attestations are weighted by stake history and any identity farming costs real capital slashed on misbehavior, making mass forgery economically ruinous. Sybil resistance here uses a staked reputation ridge: each agent locks collateral and accrues a velvet score from attested peer work, where a fresh identity starts near zero and must climb slowly. From sa0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
